commentary.text: 90+10' Miguel Ortiz is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
90+6' Arnau Martinez (Girona) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Miguel Ortiz's book.
90+5' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) but poses no threat.
90+4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Girona.
90+1' 3 - 2 Arkaitz Mariezkurrena (Real Sociedad) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike that goes inside the right post. What a clinical goal!
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
87' Here is a change. Viktor Tsygankov is going off and Michel gives the last tactical orders to Oriol Romeu (Girona).
87' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) tries his luck from a long-range free kick and fires the ball to the right side of the goal, but Alex Remiro is alert and thwarts the effort.
86' Substitution. Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Yangel Herrera walks off.
86' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) takes a direct free kick.
85' Yangel Herrera (Girona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alex Remiro, who smothers the ball.
84' The resulting set piece from Real Sociedad is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
83' The ball is out of play. Real Sociedad will have a chance to score from a corner.
81' Imanol Alguacil prepares a substitution. Javi Lopez is replaced by Arkaitz Mariezkurrena (Real Sociedad).
81' So close! Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post.
79' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Vladyslav Krapyvtsov intercepts the ball.
77' 2 - 2 Portu (Girona) latches on to a precise pass deep inside the box from Viktor Tsygankov, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low shot into the middle of the goal. He makes it 2:2.
72' The referee blows for a cooling break.
72' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
71' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Arnau Martinez (Girona) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
69' Girona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
69' Substitution. Cristhian Stuani is replaced by Portu (Girona).
65' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Hamari Traore walks off the pitch to be replaced by Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad).
65' Imanol Alguacil decides to make a substitution. Pablo Marin will be replaced by Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad).
62' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
62' This is a yellow card! Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
60' It will be a substitution. Arthur Melo (Girona) is ready to enter the pitch as Ivan Martin walks off.
60' The substitution is prepared. Abel Ruiz (Girona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jhon Elmer Solis Romero.
58' Imanol Alguacil has decided to substitute Brais Mendez and he is replaced by Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad).
58' Substitution. Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) has come on for Ander Barrenetxea.
57' Half-chance! Daley Blind (Girona) plays a pass into the box, but Alex Remiro reacts well to snuff out the attack.
57' Girona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
56' The ball is cleared after Arnau Martinez (Girona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
54' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) sends a chip pass into the box, but Alex Remiro is quickest to intercept the ball.
53' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
52' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
49' Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
47' Ivan Martin (Girona) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box, but the goalkeeper is equal to it!
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+5' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Vladyslav Krapyvtsov, who pulls off a comfortable save!
45+2' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

45+2' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) wastes an opportunity! He unleashed a strong shot from distance after the rebound fell at his feet. It went in the direction of the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulled off a nice save to deny him. Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.
45+1' Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle and signals a foul after Yangel Herrera (Girona) brought his opponent down. Real Sociedad have a free kick.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
44' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
44' An attempted cross from Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) is cleared.
42' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
39' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 5:1.
37' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header just wide of the left post!
36' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) will take a corner kick.
34' Girona are ruled offside.
33' Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
31' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Yaser Asprilla (Girona).
30' Ladislav Krejci (Girona) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
30' Miguel Ortiz blows for a foul after Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Girona are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
27' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
26' Ivan Martin (Girona) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
25' Real Sociedad have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
24' One of the Real Sociedad players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.

22' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
20' 2 - 1 Goal! Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Vladyslav Krapyvtsov.
20' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
19' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) brings his opponent down. Miguel Ortiz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY to Real Sociedad! Great chance to score.
17' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
14' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the left-hand post.
13' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
10' 1 - 1 What an excellent finish! Cristhian Stuani (Girona) latched on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and slotted the ball ino the middle of the net. Unstoppable shot!
9' The ball goes out of play. Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
7' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) is furious with himself as he misses a clear opportunity. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the right post.
5' 1 - 0 Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the left side of the goal. The score is 1:0.
5' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

4' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Vladyslav Krapyvtsov sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the roof of the net. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Real Sociedad.
4' A cross from Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
2' A pass into the penalty area from Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) is intercepted by the defence.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Girona will kick the game off.
Miguel Ortiz was nominated as the referee for this game.
